caption: A lawnmower's blade strikes a hidden stone, and a spark flicks out from under the deck.

sa.check: Its blade strikes a hidden stone.
A spark flicks out from under the deck.
The spark comes from under the deck, low to the ground.
The strike comes first and the spark follows.

pc.expect: The spark appears at the instant of the strike and only then; while the mower cuts grass alone nothing flashes under the deck.
pc.fail: Sparks flick from under the deck while the mower runs over plain grass; or sparks appear while the mower stands still; or the spark appears before the mower reaches the stone; or sparks keep coming after the strike.

pc.expect: The spark flies out low from under the deck's edge and dies at once; the stone, if it appears, is thrown out or stays under the deck.
pc.fail: The spark appears on top of the deck or at the handle; or the spark hangs in the air; or the stone flies straight up through the deck; or the spark leaves a glowing mark on the grass.

pc.expect: The spark and any thrown stone fall to the ground and come to rest; the spark goes dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: The spark rises and hangs in the air; or climbs steadily; or the stone rises and stays aloft; or lies glowing on the grass for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The mower is a rigid machine that jolts at the strike and rolls on; the deck keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The deck bends or dents deeply and springs back; or the mower bounces high into the air; or the handle wobbles like rubber.

pc.expect: One mower on the grass; the mower passes through nothing; the stone does not pass through the deck.
pc.fail: The mower passes through a tree or fence; or the stone passes up through the deck; or the mower sinks into the lawn; or a second mower appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The mower's colour, the lawn and the surroundings stay the same apart from the cut strip.
pc.fail: The mower changes colour; or the lawn changes colour away from the cut; or the surroundings rearrange.

note: Who pushes the mower is not judged. The strike itself is hidden under the deck; it is read from the mower's jolt and the spark.
